jobs.description: This website stores cookies on your computer. These cookies are used to collect information about how you interact with our website and allow us to remember you. Accept Cookie Settings NoTraffic Security The NoTraffic AI Mobility Platform is built with security at every layer-from the intersection to the cloud. Secure communications, isolated customer environments, and continuous monitoring help agencies deploy connected traffic infrastructure with confidence. Security by Design Controller to Cloud Isolation Eliminating controller security threats with Nexus embedded Firewall ​ The nexus unit uses a patent HW firewall to help protect the traffic signal controller from unauthorized access and unwanted network connections Nexus operates only within ITS-standard boundaries. Core safety parameters — minimum green, red clearance, preemption — stay read-only, protected by the cabinet’s MMU Only phase calls and status are communicated between the compute module and interface board VPN Connectivity Edge devices connect to the cloud exclusively via VPN, with internal network segmentation limiting cloud access to only the components that need it Data in transit is protected with TLS 1.2 Data at rest uses 256-bit AES encryption, from edge device all the way to the cloud Segregated Environments Ensures continuous protection and quick resolution of any issues Hosted on AWS in the US or canada, backed by 140+ AWS compliance certifications (FedRAMP, NIST, FIPS) Server hardening is performed based on CIS standards Isolated per-agency environments with constant CSPM monitoring 24/7/365 monitoring NoTraffic Operations Center PII-Free Data Only aggregated traffic data, vehicle and pedestrian counts, metadata, is captured Camera designed to meet functional needs, while not being sensitive enough for license plate or facial recognition Compliance SOC 2 Type II SOC 2 Type II certification verifies that an organization’s controls for security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy are effectively designed and operating over time. It demonstrates our commitment to safeguarding customer data through rigorous, independently audited security practices. ISO/IEC 27001 ISO/IEC 27001 is the internationally recognized standard for Information Security Management Systems (ISMS). This certification confirms that we have implemented a comprehensive framework to identify, manage, and reduce information security risks while continuously protecting sensitive customer and company data. TX-RAMP The Texas Risk and Authorization Management Program (TX-RAMP) is the security assessment and authorization framework for third-party cloud services used by Texas state agencies. TX-RAMP certification demonstrates that our platform meets the rigorous security and compliance standards required to support government organizations. *provisional CSA Star Level 1 The Cloud Security Alliance’s Security, Trust, Assurance, and Risk (STAR) program provides a framework for documenting cloud security and privacy controls. NoTraffic has completed the CAIQ v4.0.3 self-assessment based on the Cloud Controls Matrix (CCM), demonstrating transparency and a commitment to recognized cloud security practices. jobs.title: Account Executive - Mountain States
jobs.description: NoTraffic is the world’s leading mobility platform , transforming intersections into connected infrastructure that improves flow, boosts safety, and prepares cities for the autonomous era. As an Account Executive, you will drive revenue by selling NoTraffic solutions to state, county, and municipal agencies through business partners. Reporting to a Sales Director, you’ll execute sales strategies, build territory plans, and cultivate relationships to meet growth objectives. This includes identifying opportunities, developing partnerships, and closing deals that support NoTraffic’s mission to revolutionize traffic management. Your day to day will include: Achieve revenue targets by managing and developing business partners. Build and maintain strong relationships with customers and partners. Identify and pursue new opportunities through networking and referrals. Understand market trends and customer needs to tailor compelling solutions. Monitor and respond to relevant RFPs and RFIs. Represent NoTraffic at industry events, including public speaking engagements. Maintain CRM for accurate forecasting and pipeline management. 5+ years selling Intelligent Transportation Systems to government agencies. 2+ years of experience in technical sales. Proven experience managing distribution partners and growing customer accounts. Entrepreneurial spirit with a collaborative, team-focused attitude. Strong communication, problem-solving, and relationship-building skills. Ability to adapt in a dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities. Willingness to travel up to 60% within the assigned territory.

jobs.title: Product Security Lead
jobs.description: Join the future of mobility. Help build the platform that's changing how cities move. NoTraffic is the world’s leading mobility platform , transforming intersections into connected infrastructure that improves flow, boosts safety, and prepares cities for the autonomous era. We're looking for a Product Security Lead to own product security across our edge device fleet, cloud platform, and applications. It's a hands-on, senior role where your work has visible, real-world impact: our platform controls live traffic signals at thousands of intersections, so strong security is part of what makes cities trust us with their infrastructure. You'll set the security bar for the whole product and lead the work that keeps us there. Your day to day will look like: Own product security across the stack. Set the strategy and the standards for edge devices, cloud services, and the application layer. Know where our real risks are, and drive the work that reduces them Bake security into how we build. Lead security reviews of new features from design through implementation. Own how we handle secure development, dependency scanning, and secrets. Catch problems early, and give engineers clear, practical guidance instead of blockers Run vulnerability triage and response. Assess incoming vulnerabilities, judge real-world impact, and coordinate the response across R&D so the right fix ships fast Keep a living view of our security posture. Run continuous assessment across the product, maintain a risk-ranked security backlog, and make sure the highest-impact work stays at the top Harden the edge fleet. Threat-model hardware deployed in the field at customer intersections, where physical access and long device lifecycle Run penetration tests. Own the penetration testing program: Manage external 3rd-party vendors, coordinate tests, and validate findings and remediation claims. Manage compliance frameworks. SOC 2, ISO 27001, and other future industry certifications to ensure our platform maintains the highest security standards. Put AI to work. Use AI and agentic tools throughout your own work, and build them into our security stack: AI-assisted SAST, automated triage, agents that expand your coverage well past what one person could review by hand. Treat AI as a force multiplier for the whole security function ﻿ 8+ years in information security, including 2+ leading application security Deep experience with both cloud and IoT or edge-based products Hands-on with AI and agentic tools, with a track record of building them into real workflows Experience meeting the security bar that public-sector customers expect, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or NIST frameworks Strong command of network protocols Comfort in Linux and a scripting language such as Python Working knowledge of DevOps practices Nice to have: Experience securing critical infrastructure Familiarity with connected-vehicle or transportation security standards A background in offensive security or penetration testing Systems-level programming (C, C++, Go, or Rust)

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Controller to join our Finance team and take ownership of the operational accounting for revenue, COGS, inventory and related finance-operation processes.
